description: Frozen settings for the Breast5K residual-adapter experiment. Fixed before any test-set metric was computed.
dataset: Breast5K (10x Xenium Prime FFPE human breast cancer, one donor) from SydneyBioX/GHIST-Plus-bundle

split.note: Blocks are chosen from coordinates only. Train, validation and test blocks never touch (Chebyshev block distance >= 2). Cells are subsampled to exact counts inside the chosen blocks. 'rest' = every cell in a block at distance >= 2 from all train/validation blocks (secondary evaluation).

adapter.selection_metric: validation median per-gene PCC (tie-break: validation mean RMSE)
adapter.inputs: all 258 GHIST+ predicted genes, standardised with training-cell mean/std

map_genes.note: Chosen from canonical breast-tissue markers by name only; the first six present in the shared panel are plotted.
